title: Travel insurance add-on offer
description: Offer travel insurance to customers with an upcoming trip via WhatsApp, with price and coverage summary. Marketing template.
notes: Tie the offer to the traveler's booking to feel relevant. Keep it to one price and one link.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, heading to {{destination}} on {{departure_date}}? Protect your trip with travel insurance from *{{price}}*, covering medical costs, delays and lost luggage.
